title: Right boundary of the input chain
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state multi-tape Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $\ell$ be a list of circuit bit sources, let $T\in\mathbb N$, and let $w$ be a binary input. For every $t\in\mathbb N$, the input-chain value at position $|w|+1$ after $t$ steps equals the symbol read by the input head in the configuration reached after $t$ steps.
